issues.description: Silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED for turn_detection_mode breaks existing callers.
issues.detail: Flipping the default endpointing mode silently changes observable behavior (VAD emission, finalization triggers) for every caller relying on InputParams() defaults. The changelog files this under 'fixed' but it is a breaking default change. Either keep EXTERNAL as default, add a transitional warning, or call it out explicitly as a breaking change with migration notes.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced without visible import or proof it exists in the SDK.
issues.detail: _enable_vad now tests membership against EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED, but the diff shows no new import or enum addition. If the installed speechmatics package does not define FIXED, this raises AttributeError at construction. The PR needs to demonstrate the SDK 0.0.99 provides this symbol.

issues.description: process_frame now only finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, narrowing the accepted supertype contract.
issues.detail: The base STTService contract finalizes on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame; this subtype now ignores it in favor of VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. Callers wiring non-VAD producers will silently lose finalization. The branch also encodes state via flags with an elif-as-else. Either accept both frame types or document the stricter precondition at the class boundary.

issues.description: speech_segment_config is unconditionally overwritten, clobbering any vendor default.
issues.detail: config.speech_segment_config is always replaced with SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=...) even when params.split_sentences is None. This silently overrides upstream VoiceAgentConfig defaults and leaks internal assumptions through the configuration boundary. Only set the field when the user opted in, or document the frame explicitly.

issues.description: Docstring for turn_detection_mode does not clearly distinguish FIXED vs EXTERNAL semantics.
issues.detail: The docstring was updated to mark FIXED as default but still frames EXTERNAL as Pipecat-controlled endpointing, leaving readers unable to tell what guarantees each mode provides. Add a one-paragraph contract for each mode describing finalization behavior and when to choose which.

issues.description: split_sentences default coercion via `or False` obscures bool | None tri-state semantics.
issues.detail: params.split_sentences is declared bool | None = None but written as `params.split_sentences or False`, collapsing None and False. Either decide whether None means 'use library default' or 'disabled' and encode it explicitly, or write `bool(params.split_sentences)`. Small but the intent is unclear to future maintainers.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR needs work before landing. The dominant concern is a silent breaking change: the default turn_detection_mode flips from EXTERNAL to FIXED, mislabeled as a fix, altering behavior for any caller using InputParams() defaults. A second high-priority concern is that EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced without visible import evidence, risking AttributeError at construction. The frame-handling rewrite narrows the accepted finalization frame type, an LSP-adjacent contract change. Smaller issues include unconditional clobbering of speech_segment_config, unclear FIXED vs EXTERNAL docstring semantics, and `or False` coercion that obscures tri-state intent.
